TEN STORIES · AN AETHER, FABLE AND FIORA COLLECTION

Lux Lit Compendium

The Definitive Anthology. Ten picture books from Palawan: Tagbanua, Cuyunen and Calamianen heritage, families, fireflies, moons and rainbows. All ten competed in the Gawad Teodora Alonzo, and three became Regional Finalists. Each one plays as a movie with read-aloud, or opens as a book you turn page by page.

Venice D. Rodriguez is a Grade 1 teacher and children’s book author from Palawan. Her Si Pagsarayen, Ang Layag at Ang Mga Tala won 2nd Place at the Division Level of the Gawad Teodora Alonzo in 2023, and three of her books, Si Pagsarayen, Ang Bata sa Buwan (Yng Mula Tung Bulan) and Bahagharing Lahi, became Regional Finalists. Ang Bata sa Buwan is published by Chikiting Books (Vibal Group). Her stories celebrate Tagbanua, Cuyunen and Calamianen heritage, family, and the courage to be yourself.
